findings.message: Static/server output and public assets report zero matches for personaTemplateId, behaviorInstructions, answerKey, rubric, targetDiagnosis, and patientFacts. The public journey contains only the stated public projection fields and reports sensitiveMatches=0.
IndexedDB, localStorage, and sessionStorage were observed in the runtime scan with zero sensitive matches. IndexedDB contained two values, while localStorage and sessionStorage were empty.
Console and CacheStorage were observed with zero sensitive matches; CacheStorage was empty. The scan also reports failedSurfaces=0.
The current game shell does not expose a save-export surface, so save leakage was not scanned and is not claimed as verified. This is an evidence limitation rather than an observed leakage.

The journey artifacts explicitly separate public/e4-cross-layer-journey.v1.json with visibility public from private/e4-cross-layer-journey.v1.json with visibility private. The public artifact reports sensitiveMatches=0; no private evidence is shown as included in the public artifact.
